findings.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE (CVE-2026-103849) - Sansec
findings.summary_md: Sansec published its BlockStrap analysis on October 15, identifying CVE-2026-103849 as a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaw in Magento and Adobe Commerce through version 2.4.9 (B2B through 1.5.3). The firm found four potential attack paths in under 24 hours and warned that Adobe's priority-2 rating underestimates urgency, comparing complexity to the StyleSmuggler zero-day that moved from hotfix to mass exploitation in three days. No in-the-wild exploitation had been observed at the time of publication.

findings.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-153
findings.summary_md: Adobe released APSB26-153 on October 13, 2026, describing CVE-2026-103849 as an improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine leading to arbitrary code execution. The bulletin covers Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source through 2.4.9 and Adobe Commerce B2B through 1.5.3, assigning priority 2 (patch within 30 days). Adobe's fix requires a manual patch or the 2026-oct release for new installs.

findings.title: Critical BlockStrap flaw lets hackers run code on Magento servers - BleepingComputer
findings.summary_md: BleepingComputer reported the BlockStrap vulnerability on October 16, confirming the CVSS 10.0 rating and the impact on Magento and Adobe Commerce through 2.4.9. The article notes that attacks have not yet been observed but that threat actors are expected to exploit it, and highlights that a plain Composer install is insufficient without Adobe's isolated BlockStrap patch plus the earlier StyleSmuggler hotfix.
